title: macos-14 runner cannot build with Xcode 26
detail: The macos-14 image ships Xcode 15.0.1 to 16.2 (default 15.4). Since 28 Apr 2026 App Store Connect requires Xcode 26 or later with an iOS 26 SDK. GitHub retires macos-14 on 2 Nov 2026 with brownouts from 5 Oct 2026.

title: macOS runner label no longer offered by GitHub
detail: macos-13 and older labels are not in the actions/runner-images list any more; the job never starts, and those images never had Xcode 26.

title: macos-15 builds with Xcode 16.4 unless you select Xcode 26
detail: The macos-15 image (arm64 and Intel) defaults to Xcode 16.4. A job that archives or uploads without selecting Xcode 26 produces a build App Store Connect rejects since 28 Apr 2026.

title: Pinned Xcode is below 26
detail: The job selects an Xcode older than 26 (setup-xcode xcode-version, xcode-select -s or DEVELOPER_DIR). App Store Connect rejects uploads built with it since 28 Apr 2026.

title: Pinned Xcode is not installed on this runner image
detail: The runner image does not ship the Xcode version the job selects, so the select step fails before the build starts. macos-15 has 26.0.1, 26.1.1, 26.2 and 26.3; macos-26 has 26.0.1 to 26.6.
fix: pick a version the image lists, or runs-on: macos-26

title: iOS deployment target below 13
detail: Since 9 Sep 2026 iOS and iPadOS apps uploaded to App Store Connect must target iOS 13 or later.

title: xcodebuild -sdk names an SDK below 26
detail: An explicit versioned -sdk (for example iphoneos18.5) builds against an SDK older than iOS 26; uploads need an iOS, iPadOS, tvOS, visionOS or watchOS 26 SDK since 28 Apr 2026.

title: Self-hosted Mac job does not select an Xcode
detail: A self-hosted macOS runner builds with whatever /Applications/Xcode.app is on that machine; nothing in the workflow proves it is Xcode 26.

title: macos-latest moves without notice
detail: macos-latest points to the macOS 26 arm64 image today (default Xcode 26.6). GitHub migrates -latest labels over 1-2 months, so a release job gets a different Xcode on a later run.

title: Which Xcode this job builds with
detail: For every job that archives or uploads an Apple build: the runner image, the Xcode it resolves to (explicit pin or image default) and whether that meets the Xcode 26 upload minimum.
